# HeaderCard

Figma: [07l. HeaderCard](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=3284-3605) · Family: 07 Cards & Lists · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

The deal / project page hero - one design language across Mobile and Web (photo + circular overlay controls + qualified medallion + title/developer/meta/developer-row), in Expanded and Collapsed states, RTL & LTR. Composes the product Header, Deal_Tags and Syntropy icons.

Reference image (every variant, labelled): `knowledge/examples/components/header-card/reference.png`

### Base card

HeaderCard: the deal page hero that tops a single deal or project detail screen with the photo gallery and overlay back, share and favorite controls, qualified medallion, title, developer, meta tags and developer row; collapses to a sticky title bar (with Invest CTA on web).

Level: organism · Contains: Header, dealTags, Tag, Avatar, IconButton

Use when:
- Top of a deal or project detail page, once per screen (State=Expanded)
- Sticky bar while scrolling the deal page (State=Collapsed)
- Web deal page using the same design widened (Platform=Web)

Don't use when:
- Deal cards in a feed or list: use CardDeal
- Updates about the deal: use NewsCard
- Generic screen headers: use AppBar
- A separate desktop layout with breadcrumbs: keep Base card for both platforms

Accessibility: Deal title is the page h1; overlay icon buttons need labels (Back, Share, Save) and contrast over the photo; gallery counter announced (1 of 5).

> Not published to the Figma library. Use it by name everywhere; in another Figma file take its published route or copy it from the Syntropy file (syntropy-components, unpublished.md).

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

HeaderCard tops a deal / project detail screen. The hero sells the project with its photo; the info block gives the essentials - what it is, the qualified status, the developer and key highlights. Same composition on phone and desktop, just widened. One per detail screen; for a browsable list use CardDeal (07a).

### Anatomy

Hero photo with overlaid back · share · favorite (circular) + carousel arrows + page counter; then the qualified medallion (Deal_Tags), title + developer, meta Tags and a developer row.

Expanded hero

### Web - Expanded & Collapsed

Desktop hero (1120-wide, same look as mobile) and the sticky bar shown on scroll (title + Share/Save + Invest CTA).

Expanded

Collapsed (sticky)

### Mobile - Expanded & Collapsed

The phone hero (390-wide, with iOS status bar) and its collapsed sticky title bar. (Mobile · Expanded live instance pending a 2-component font fix - shown in the variant reference.)

### Direction - RTL & LTR

Mirrors fully - overlay controls, carousel and the entire info block flip; Arabic reads right-to-left.

### Code examples

Flutter - one HeaderCard, responsive by platform/state.

```dart
SafqahHeaderCard(
  platform: context.isWide ? Platform.web : Platform.mobile,
  state: collapsed ? HeaderState.collapsed : HeaderState.expanded,
  images: deal.photos,
  title: deal.name,
  subtitle: deal.developer.name,
  qualified: deal.qualifiedOnly,        // Deal_Tags medallion
  meta: ['Prime location', 'Residential', 'Flexible terms', 'Dividend payouts'],
  developer: DeveloperRef(verified: true, name: deal.developer.name, logo: deal.developer.logo),
  onBack: ..., onShare: ..., onFavorite: ...,
)
```

### Usage - Do & Don’t

Do

Keep mobile and web as the same HeaderCard - one design language, widened for desktop.

Don’t

Don’t invent a separate desktop layout (breadcrumbs, ghost buttons, a different gallery) - that breaks consistency.

Do

Use the collapsed sticky bar on scroll so the back control + title (and Invest CTA on web) stay reachable.

Don’t

Don’t use HeaderCard in a feed/list - for browsable deal cards use CardDeal (07a).
